newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Icatu Hartford to represent Swiss Life in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Icatu Hartford to represent Swiss Life in Brazil.

text.p: Brazilian life insurance company Icatu Hartford Seguros said it has formed an association to represent Swiss Life in Brazil to offer services to Swiss Life's multinational clients.

"Swiss Life leads an international pool of insurers to provide insurance services to multinational companies. We will become more competitive being part of that group," Icatu Hartford vice-president Carlos Alberto Trindade told Reuters.
Trindade said the companies will sign a contract on Dec 11 at a ceremony in Zurich.
Under the agreement, Icatu Hartford will be responsible for the management of 27 group life insurance policies of Swiss Life's Brazilian clients, which are subsidiaries of multinational companies.
Trindade said Icatu Hartford plans to expand Swiss Life's insurance services to 50 companies in Brazil, increasing premiums five-fold to 10 million reais next year.

Icatu Hartford, which is a joint venture between Brazilian Icatu group and U.S. ITT Hartford Group Inc, posted 180 million reais ($174.8 million) in premiums in the first nine-months of the year, up 20 percent from the same period last year.
Trindade said the company's premiums are expected to jump to 230 million reais ($223.4 million) this year, against 150 million reais ($145.7 million) posted in 1995.
